coverage_note: Covers the cryo-TEM makers that sell dedicated cryo platforms (Thermo Fisher, JEOL), cryo-FIB/SEM (Thermo, JEOL, TESCAN, ZEISS+Quorum, Hitachi option), cryo holders (Gatan, Fischione, Simple Origin, Mel-Build), cryo-SEM prep/transfer (Quorum, Gatan Alto, Leica VCT500), cryo-CLEM stages and in-chamber FLM (Linkam, Delmic), cryo lift-out (Oxford Instruments, Kleindiek) and MicroED diffractometers (Rigaku/JEOL, ELDICO). The shared WebSearch budget ran out mid-run, so these were not searched: Titan Krios G2/G3i and original Glacios datasheets, Talos L120C (generic TEM with cryo holder), Gatan CT3500/910, Leica VCT500 brochure PDF, Zeiss Crossbeam spec PDFs, Delmic ENZEL, Chinese/Korean/Indian domestic cryo-EM makers (none found before the budget ran out). gatan.com, delmic.com, directindustry and thermofisher.cn refuse the snapshot tool (429/403/security page). There is overlap with vitrification_and_cryo_preparation for Gatan holders and Alto, Fischione 2550, Simple Origin, Quorum and Leica VCT500, so dedupe on url/model. The ESRF, UCSB and Illinois facility pages are not used as sources because they describe single installations.
